_meta.description: Evidence-based rubric for scoring EHR/RCM platforms across 8 RCM gates. Each gate has 5-6 criteria; each criterion scored 0 (No/Broken), 0.5 (Partial), or 1.0 (Full). Gate score = weighted average mapped to 1-4 scale.

score_map.1: Legacy — architecture does not support this capability
score_map.2: Emerging — basic support exists, significant gaps or manual workarounds required
score_map.4: Best-in-Class — automated, minimal manual intervention, leading capability

_meta.context: Florida Medicaid behavioral health — CMHC/BHPF member profile

criteria.label: Automated appointment reminders (SMS/email/voice)
criteria.rationale: No-show rate in BH is 28-45%; automated reminders directly reduce this

criteria.label: Patient self-scheduling portal (24/7 online booking)
criteria.rationale: Access point for new patient acquisition; reduces front-desk burden

criteria.label: Digital intake / consent forms (pre-visit, mobile-friendly)
criteria.rationale: Reduces no-show paperwork burden; improves clean claim rate

criteria.label: No-show / cancellation risk prediction (AI/ML scoring)
criteria.rationale: Predictive overbooking could recover 8-12% of revenue lost to no-shows

criteria.label: BH-specific scheduling (recurring, group therapy, multi-disciplinary)
criteria.rationale: Critical for BH workflow; generic schedulers require extensive manual config

criteria.label: Patient engagement history / communication log
criteria.rationale: Needed for HEDIS / AHCA reporting requirements

criteria.label: Real-time 270/271 eligibility transactions
criteria.rationale: Batch-only means eligibility is stale at point of service; increases denials

criteria.label: FL Medicaid MCO connectivity (Sunshine, Molina, Simply, WellCare, Humana)
criteria.rationale: FL Medicaid is 100% managed care; MCO-specific rules differ materially

criteria.label: BH-specific benefit detail (auth requirements, session limits, BH co-pays)
criteria.rationale: Generic eligibility misses BH carve-out rules; leads to auth denials

criteria.label: Automated re-verification at appointment (not just at registration)
criteria.rationale: Medicaid eligibility can change monthly; re-verify at service date

criteria.label: Coverage gap / termination alert before service delivery
criteria.rationale: Prevents uncompensated care delivery

criteria.label: FL AHCA Medicaid fee schedule — automated updates
criteria.rationale: FL Medicaid fee schedule updates quarterly; manual maintenance is a billing risk

criteria.label: BH-specific LCD/NCD rule engine (H-codes, T-codes, CPT mod rules)
criteria.rationale: BH billing codes have distinct coverage policies not in general medical rules engines

criteria.label: Gold Carding / prior auth bypass rule tracking
criteria.rationale: FL Medicaid gold carding reduces PA burden for established patients; if not tracked, orgs over-authorize

criteria.label: Annual session / visit limit tracking per member per payer
criteria.rationale: BH payers impose session limits; exceeding without tracking = denial

criteria.label: Multi-payer rule management (MCO-specific policy differences)
criteria.rationale: FL has 5+ major Medicaid MCOs with different BH policies

criteria.label: License / DEA / malpractice expiration tracking with alerts
criteria.rationale: Expired credentials = Medicaid billing suspension; requires proactive monitoring

criteria.label: Real-time Medicaid enrollment status monitoring
criteria.rationale: FL Medicaid enrollment can be suspended without notice; billing against suspended NPI = recoupment

criteria.label: 90-day Medicaid blackout window detection for new hires
criteria.rationale: New provider Medicaid enrollment takes 60-90 days in FL; billing before approval = fraud risk. No platform detects this automatically.

criteria.label: NPI taxonomy validation vs. scope-of-practice and payer credentialing
criteria.rationale: Taxonomy mismatch is leading cause of BH credentialing denials in FL Medicaid

criteria.label: Cross-org shared credentialing pool (network-level, not single-org)
criteria.rationale: This is the Mobius differentiator — no EHR supports cross-org credentialing natively

criteria.label: CAQH ProView / NPPES direct integration for credential verification
criteria.rationale: Manual CAQH updates take 2-4 weeks; direct integration reduces lag

criteria.label: PA workflow with automated electronic submission (not manual fax)
criteria.rationale: Manual PA submission averages 20 min/request; automation required for BH volume

criteria.label: Payer-specific auth rules engine (MCO-level, not generic)
criteria.rationale: FL MCOs have different PA thresholds, timeframes, and clinical criteria

criteria.label: Gold Carding / PA bypass for qualified established patients
criteria.rationale: FL SB 1226 gold carding law; non-compliance = unnecessary PA spend

criteria.label: Auth expiration tracking with renewal alerts before service gap
criteria.rationale: Expired auth = retroactive denial; common in long-term BH treatment

criteria.label: Denial likelihood scoring / predictive PA flagging
criteria.rationale: Predictive flagging allows front-loading of documentation before submission

criteria.label: BH-specific HCPCS H-codes and T-codes (SUD, crisis, community BH)
criteria.rationale: FL Medicaid BH uses H-codes and T-codes extensively; general medical engines default wrong

criteria.label: FL Medicaid modifier rules (GT, 95, HO, HN, HM, U1-U9 modifiers)
criteria.rationale: FL Medicaid has BH-specific modifier requirements; wrong modifiers = systematic denials

criteria.label: Pre-submission claim scrubbing with real-time edit validation
criteria.rationale: Clean claim rate directly drives denial rate; scrubbing catches errors before payer rejection

criteria.label: ICD-10 BH diagnosis crosswalk (DSM-5 aligned, quarterly updates)
criteria.rationale: DSM-5 to ICD-10 mapping errors are a common BH billing failure point

criteria.label: Real-time claim status tracking post-submission
criteria.rationale: Without real-time status, denials surface in AR aging 45+ days late

criteria.label: Automated denial categorization and routing to correct worklist
criteria.rationale: Manual denial triage wastes 30-45 min/denial; automation required at BH volume

criteria.label: Appeal workflow automation with payer-specific templates
criteria.rationale: Timely filing limits require fast appeal submission; manual process misses windows

criteria.label: Denial pattern analytics and root cause identification
criteria.rationale: Without pattern analytics, orgs fix symptoms not causes; denial rate stays flat

criteria.label: Cross-org denial intelligence (network-level pattern learning)
criteria.rationale: Single-org analytics miss MCO-level patterns; cross-org learning would surface systematic payer behavior

criteria.label: Pre-submission denial prediction (flag high-risk claims before send)
criteria.rationale: Predictive flagging can reduce denial rate 3-5 percentage points

criteria.label: Automated 835 ERA posting with exception handling
criteria.rationale: Manual ERA posting is the #1 driver of high AR days; full automation targets <40 AR days

criteria.label: Payment reconciliation with variance detection (underpayment flagging)
criteria.rationale: FL Medicaid underpays systematically; without variance detection, revenue leaks silently

criteria.label: AI-prioritized AR worklist (highest recovery probability first)
criteria.rationale: Staff working highest-value claims first recovers 15-22% more per FTE hour

criteria.label: AR days tracking by payer with trend analysis
criteria.rationale: Payer-level AR visibility drives targeted follow-up

criteria.label: Patient balance management and statement automation
criteria.rationale: BH patients often have complex Medicaid/commercial splits
